verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents running code in an isolated cloud sandbox (docs-1) through stateful REPL or stateless Cmd contexts (docs-21), and templates built from public or private images (docs-23, docs-24) imply arbitrary language runtimes can be installed. However, the evidence never names supported runtimes such as Python or JavaScript, and never describes structured or rich result output. missing for 10: explicitly documented multi-language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, others), rich result types such as charts, images or structured outputs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
